Region plots need identified participant estimates, explicit contrast/model/units and covariance availability, failed-sample identities, and exact inference/admission receipts. Descriptive profiles, adjusted means and contrasts remain distinct. Regional intervals must not assume independent voxels, and a displayed cluster does not confer regional or corrected significance. We will recheck your precise admitted designs and revisions before enabling group defaults; oracle controls stay diagnostic.

The user requires every QA plot to be examined for beauty and excellence, including calibration/coverage/power plots. Our standard requires actual image inspection, per-artifact critique, exact output/source hashes, readable uncertainty and failure labels, and retained failed/refined specimens. General Intaglio deficiencies must be reproduced/fixed in Intaglio and reverified downstream; merely filing a defect is insufficient for acceptance. This does not require changing your independent numerical reference tools to Intaglio.

No action is requested on your current computations. This records the consumer boundary and shared visual standard; I will consult your live issue/evidence again before adoption.
